Header and terminal block outlines are not modeled as separate features.

Header lengths, positions, and pin counts are approximate.
Terminal block size and position are estimated; screw heads, wire openings and individual pockets are not modeled.
Capacitor count (5), diameter, and positions are estimated from the photo.
